texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Angadanan: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Aug 16-31 - Corn season 2 - Maturing. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in Angadanan. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Angadanan
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk.
ACAP calendar: Aug 16-31 - Corn season 2 - Maturing.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - Angadanan: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Angadanan: 10 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Angadanan. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Angadanan
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Angadanan: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

decision_support.immediate_farmer_action: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in San Mariano. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
decision_support.lgu_da_action:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - San Mariano
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk.
ACAP calendar: Aug 16-31 - Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Reproductive.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
decision_support.public_advisory: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - San Mariano: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Reproductive. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.
decision_support.sms_ready: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in San Mariano. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
decision_support.when_to_recheck: Re-check after the next 6:00 AM PHT pipeline run, and immediately when PAGASA issues or updates warnings.

calendar_anchor.note: Current rice/corn stages are anchored to the municipal ACAP crop calendar.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

texts.bulletin: POSTHARVEST DRYING RISK - San Mateo: Drying class is high_risk. Avoid open sun-drying if rain/high humidity persists. Prioritize mechanical dryers, tarpaulins, covered temporary storage, and rapid hauling to postharvest facilities.
texts.sms: DA WARNING: Drying risk in San Mateo. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.

POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - San Mateo
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
texts.facebook: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - San Mateo: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.

DISEASE WATCH - San Mateo
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - San Mateo: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
